description: This file declares the RemotePlugin class which implements the Rust::IPlugin interface for a plugin system. It includes methods for initialization, deinitialization, invocation, activation, deactivation, and message handling, along with private methods for launching a remote process and sending data. The class interacts with socket communication, plugin channels, and Rust configuration data.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A plugin class that interfaces with Rust code, manages remote processes, and communicates over sockets. Implements plugin lifecycle and messaging functions with support for different Thunder framework versions.
